mapper.select: /* selectRegion - HeeSung Yoon */ SELECT DISTINCT CTPV_SE_CD, CTPV_NM FROM SAA020
/* selectRegion2 - HeeSung Yoon */ SELECT SGG_CD, SGG_NM, CTPV_SE_CD FROM SAA020 ORDER BY SRTNG_SQNCE
/* selectPicAgency - HeeSung Yoon */ SELECT INST_NO, INST_NM, RGN_CD FROM SAA000 WHERE UP_INST_NO = '100'
/* selectPicStation - HeeSung Yoon */ SELECT INST_NO, INST_NM, RGN_CD, SGG_CD FROM SAA000 WHERE INST_NM LIKE '%경찰서' AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U01'

/* selectUserHisList - HeeSung Yoon */ SELECT INST_NO, TO_CHAR(MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MDFCN_DT, INST_NM, C##RG.DEC_B64(PIC_NM_ENCPT) AS PIC_NM_ENCPT, PIC_TELNO, C##RG.DEC_B64(PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT, APRV_YN FROM SAA001 WHERE INST_NO = #{INST_NO}
